name: Erurana Welgalia
original_name: エルラーナ・ウェルガリア
source:
She has a dignified demeanor, a beautiful, well-rounded face, and a full-bodied body that bears a resemblance to her mother's. She is engaged to a beautiful young man, the son of a great nobleman. Erurana is in love with her good looking fiancé.

Although she is a virgin, she has an overflowing desire for him. She is strict with men, and although she is strict with the protagonist, she is not thorough, and ends up always spoiling him.
